system.special:
Animal Form: In animal form, a lycanthrope can be harmed only by magical weapons, silvered weapons, or spells. It cannot speak normal languages, but can speak with normal animals of its weretype. Human Form: In human form a lycanthrope often looks somewhat like its wereform. It can speak and use weapons normally. Summon Animals: Any lycanthrope can summon 1d2 normal animals of its type; they arrive in 1d4 rounds. Wolfsbane: If hit by wolfsbane, the lycanthrope must save vs. poison or flee in fear.

Charm: Three times per day; lasts up to 24 hours (persons in human form, animals in fox form).

Swimming: 90' (30').

Human Form AC: 9.
system.description: Werefoxes move at full speed even through dense underbrush and are highly intelligent, often becoming magic-users who can cast only in human form. They can charm three times per day, for up to 24 hours: persons in human form, animals in fox form. They swim at 90' (30').
